methodology: Only public universities are in scope: private institutions are excluded before any other gate, so no ownership tag is carried on a row. Universities are retained only when all inclusive gates are evidenced: EduRank 2026 overall world rank of 1,000 or better nationwide, or 3,200 or better for a qualifying programme campus in a city already listed in the German city scoreboard; at least one current on-campus, computing-centred degree that accepts foreign credentials and can be completed in English; and mandatory Bangladeshi/non-EU tuition of €5,000 or less per semester. English admission evidence or isolated English modules do not establish an English-completable pathway. Domain programmes qualify only when computing is central and a CSE-related prior degree is explicitly accepted. Intake chips record a portal state verified against the official source on the dataset review date: "Open now" means applications were being accepted that day, "Opens <month>" carries an officially published opening date, and a row with neither chip has no published opening date. Official university sources govern programmes, admission, tuition, intakes and campuses; EduRank is used for ranks. Subject ranks are shown only when directly confirmed and otherwise remain absent. Semester contributions and application charges are separate from tuition.
caveats: The shortlist is public-universities-only by design. Private institutions are out of scope and are never listed, whatever their rank or English provision.
The inclusion rules are conjunctive: failing rank, English-completable computing programme, international admission, or tuition removes the institution.
Admission is not guaranteed. Every applicant must match formal subject-credit, grade and language rules; software work experience rarely replaces missing academic credits.
€0 denotes no programme tuition, not free study: semester contributions, application fees, visa funding, insurance and living costs still apply.
Future application dates are stated only when officially published or as clearly labelled recurring programme deadlines; always verify the live portal.
EduRank is an independent bibliometric provider. Overall rank is mandatory; missing subject ranks are not inferred.
Approximate map pins identify the official campus neighbourhood and are not building-entrance coordinates.
